final_resume.summary: B.Tech Information Technology graduate (2023) with 6 months of internship experience building backend services in Java and Spring Boot.

projects.name: ShopEase - E-commerce Store
projects.description: Spring Boot and MySQL e-commerce backend with a React storefront, deployed on AWS EC2 with product images on S3; supports cart, checkout and order history.

bullets: Built 6 REST endpoints in Spring Boot for the order-returns module backed by MySQL.
Wrote JUnit tests for the returns service, raising module coverage from 45% to 70%.
Fixed 12 production bugs reported by the support team during the internship.

profile_improvement_tips: Gain hands-on experience with Python or JavaScript to match the JD's core language requirements; consider contributing to open-source projects or building a small backend service in Python.

Study and practise system design concepts (scalability, load balancing, caching, database sharding) through resources like Grokking the System Design Interview; document a design exercise in your portfolio.

Deepen your understanding of distributed systems principles (consensus, replication, fault tolerance) and implement a small distributed project (e.g. a multi-node cache or message queue) to demonstrate practical knowledge.

Familiarise yourself with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services (Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Firestore) by completing the Google Cloud Skills Boost labs and deploying a project on GCP instead of AWS.
Contribute to code reviews in open-source projects or team settings to build a track record of providing constructive feedback on code quality and style.
final_resume.growth_note: You are a fresher with 6 months of internship experience, well below the 1-year minimum stated in the JD. Your Java and Spring Boot foundation is strong, but you lack experience in 8 of the 10 curated keywords (JavaScript, Python, C++, System Design, Distributed Systems, Code Review, GCP, NLP, UI/UX). Focus on gaining 1+ year of professional backend development experience, learning Python or JavaScript, and studying system design before applying to mid-level roles at Google Cloud.
